requests.brief: New sim, to be built by sim-builder as our own bundle; no PhET code, art or layout (PhET sims are CC BY-NC 4.0). Concept: phy.work-energy-power.collisions.core.elastic-inelastic-collisions. Learning goal: send cart 1 into cart 2 (at rest) on a level frictionless track and see that total momentum is the same before and after every collision, while total kinetic energy is kept only in an elastic collision; equal masses exchange velocities, and a light cart bounces back off a heavy one. Model, one-dimensional, cart 2 at rest: elastic, v1f = (m1 - m2) v1 / (m1 + m2), v2f = 2 m1 v1 / (m1 + m2); completely inelastic, both move at m1 v1 / (m1 + m2) and the kinetic energy lost is m1 m2 v1^2 / (2 (m1 + m2)). Params: m1 (kg, 0.5 to 5, default 1), m2 (kg, 0.5 to 5, default 3), v1 (m/s, 0.5 to 8, default 4), elastic (1 for elastic, 0 for the carts sticking together, default 1). Controls: sliders for m1, m2 and v1, a two-way switch for elastic or sticking, launch, pause, reset. Show momentum and kinetic-energy bars before and after, each with a text label and value (not colour alone). Background art, if any, comes from visual-director, not drawn in the sim. Readouts the card reads: v1_final (m/s, signed, positive in cart 1's starting direction), v2_final (m/s), ke_lost (J). Card tasks with v1 = 4: m1 = m2 = 1, elastic, v2_final 4 m/s; m1 = 1, m2 = 3, elastic, v1_final -2 m/s; m1 = 1, m2 = 3, sticking, ke_lost 6 J. Model tests: these values, and NCERT Example 5.11 (elastic, m2 = 2 m1: cart 1 keeps 1/9 of its kinetic energy). Reduced motion: no sliding animation; show the before and after states and the readouts at once.
